title: A fork becomes the adopter's engineering environment

spec.description: An engineer can fork or clone this repository and use it as the engineering environment for their own project. Golden Path framework state in engineering/ explains and governs the environment; optional adopter state in project/ explains and governs the system being built. A fresh fork contains the engineering discipline but no assumptions about what the adopter is building: missing project state means the adopter's outcome is not yet known. The adopter's outcomes, workloads, requirements, decisions, capabilities, policies, implementation mappings, evaluations and evidence persist in project/ under the same schema and invariants, with zero or more workloads. Framework provenance must not become adopter authority: framework requirements, decisions, approvals, policies, evaluations and evidence cannot satisfy project authority or traceability. Engineering state should explain implementation boundaries, not inventory every source file.
